changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Issue zeros can come from an absent provider count. Keep them unknown until a backfill supplies the count. Positive counts and pull requests keep their values.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE issue SET comments_count = NULL WHERE issue_type = 'ISSUE' AND comments_count = 0

rollback.stop: Restore the verified database backup taken before the issue comment count correction.
